helpCenter.title: Help center
helpCenter.description: Publish your documents as a public website your customers can search and read.
helpCenter.loadFailed: We could not load your help center.
helpCenter.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

disabled.title: Help centers are not set up on this server
disabled.description: This server has no help center domain, so there is nowhere to publish a site. If you host Hay yourself, set HELP_CENTER_DOMAIN in the server's environment and restart it.

notLive.title: Your help center is not live yet
notLive.description: Nobody outside your team can see it. Add your content, check the preview, then go live from the Overview tab.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.description: Your appearance changes have not been saved. If you leave now, they are lost.

basics.name: Name
basics.nameHint: Shown at the top of the site and in browser tabs.
basics.addressCheckFailed: We could not check this address right now. You can continue: it is checked again when you save.
basics.addressInvalid: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, and start and end with a letter or number.
basics.addressReserved: That address is reserved. Choose another one.
basics.addressTaken: That address is already taken. Choose another one.
basics.languageHint: The language of the site's own labels, such as the search box. Your articles are shown as written.

theme.accentColorInvalid: Enter a 6-digit hex colour, such as #2747d6.
theme.contrastWarning: On a white page this colour has a contrast of {ratio}:1, below the 4.5:1 that text needs. Links will be shown in the normal text colour instead of this one; buttons stay readable.

layouts.listHint: Every article listed under its collection.

theme.heroSubtitlePlaceholder: Search our guides or browse by topic.

collection.title: Title
collection.iconHint: Pick one above or type any emoji. Leave it empty for no icon.

picker.loadFailed: We could not load your documents.
picker.noDocuments: You have no documents yet. Create or import some under Documents first.

basics.title: Name your help center
basics.description: Choose what it is called and where people will find it. You can change all of this later.

brand.title: Make it yours
brand.description: Pick a colour, a font and a layout. You can fine-tune these with a live preview afterwards.

content.title: Add your first collection
content.description: Collections group related articles, such as Getting started or Billing. You can skip this and add content later.
content.documents: Documents to put in this collection

setup.createFailed: Could not create your help center
setup.createdNotLive: It is not live yet. Review it, then go live when you are ready.
setup.createdPartly: Your help center was created, but part of the setup did not finish. Check the Content and Appearance tabs.

articles.publicNotice: Adding marks these documents as public. Once your site is live, anyone on the internet can read the published ones.
articles.addDescription: Pick the documents to show in this collection. A document can be in one collection at a time.
articles.addConfirm: Add articles | Add 1 article | Add {count} articles

overview.liveDescription: Your help center is live: anyone on the internet can open it.
overview.offlineDescription: Your help center is offline: visitors see a "not found" page.
overview.liveArticles: No articles are ready to show yet. | 1 article is ready to show. | {count} articles are ready to show.
overview.detailsDescription: The name, address and language of your help center.
overview.addressChangeWarning: Changing the address breaks links to the old one, including links people have saved or shared.
overview.searchIndexing: Search engines can index this site
overview.searchIndexingHint: Turn this off to ask search engines such as Google not to list your help center.
overview.goLiveDescription: Your help center will be public at {url}. It has no articles ready to show yet, so visitors will see an empty site. | Your help center will be public at {url}. 1 article becomes visible to anyone on the internet. | Your help center will be public at {url}. {count} articles become visible to anyone on the internet.
overview.goOfflineDescription: Visitors will see a "not found" page and links to your articles will stop working until you go live again. Nothing is deleted.

content.intro: An article shows on your site when its document is published, public and placed in a collection.
content.loadFailed: We could not load your collections.
content.emptyDescription: Collections group related articles on your site. Create one, then add documents to it.
content.noArticles: This collection has no articles yet.
content.collectionDialogHint: Visitors see the title, description and icon on your site's home page.
content.deleteDescription: The collection and its place on your site are removed, and its articles leave the help center. The documents themselves are not deleted.
content.articleRemoved: Article removed from the help center
content.stillPublicHint: The documents are still marked public. You can change that on each document's page.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Changes show in the preview straight away. Visitors see them once you save.
appearance.previewUnavailable: The preview is not available right now. You can still change and save your settings.

domain.title: Custom domain
domain.description: Serve your help center from your own domain. Your built-in address, {address}, keeps working either way.
domain.addHint: Use a subdomain you control, such as help.yourcompany.com. You will add one DNS record to prove it is yours.
domain.pendingIntro: To connect {domain}, add one of these records where you manage its DNS, then check.
domain.recordsHint: Use the CNAME record if you can: it also sends visitors to your help center. If your DNS provider hides CNAME records, for example when the domain is proxied through Cloudflare, add the TXT record to prove the domain is yours.
domain.verifyFailed: We could not check the domain right now. Try again in a moment.
domain.httpsNote: After a new domain is verified, HTTPS can take a few minutes to start working.
domain.removeDescription: Your help center will stop answering on this domain, and links that use it will break. It stays available at {address}.
